open_points.subject: Anonymised Project
open_points.text: M01 says an anonymised project keeps “its `project_id`, its status, that mark and its artifact pointers”; R0-62 says it keeps “its id, status and artifact pointers and nothing else.”
open_points.question: Is the anonymised mark a persisted Project fact, or must anonymisation be inferred from the absence of the erased facts?
options: Persist an explicit anonymised mark
Keep only id, archived status and pointers; infer anonymisation
open_points.default_guess: Persist an explicit anonymised mark because reads and later erasure attempts must distinguish an anonymised project from an ordinary archived one.

open_points.subject: Imported Project display name
open_points.text: The primary import action says “each with a new display name and alias when the owner gives them,” while R0-85 says the owner “may give each a new display name and an alias”; R0-82 requires projects imported under a person’s name to be renamed in the import.
open_points.question: For each imported project, when is a new display name required rather than optional?
options: Require a new display name for every imported project
Require one only when the source name violates the naming rule
Always allow the source display name to remain
open_points.default_guess: Require a new display name for every imported project.

open_points.subject: Object authority
open_points.text: M02 says “Source of truth: The owner, recorded in the project card,” while State 0 says Registry is the single living owner of project identity, including the object and its address and characteristics.
open_points.question: Is Registry’s stored Object value authoritative after recording, or is the owner an external source of truth whose value Registry merely reflects?
options: Registry’s stored Project/Object record is authoritative
The owner remains the authoritative source and Registry is only a recorded copy
open_points.default_guess: Treat production Registry’s stored Project/Object record as authoritative and the owner as the actor supplying corrections.

open_points.subject: Imported Room added instant
open_points.text: A Room always carries “the instant it was added,” and the import “keeps … a room’s added instant,” but the texts do not say what happens when the source does not carry that instant.
open_points.question: What added instant does an imported Room receive when no source instant exists?
options: Use the import instant
Require the migration input to supply a reconstructed instant
Allow an imported Room to have no added instant

open_points.subject: Customer contact-data presence
open_points.text: M04 lists “name, phone, e-mail, language” as Customer facts but, unlike fiscal values, does not say which may be absent; the record action refuses only a missing name or kind.
open_points.question: At Customer recording, are phone, e-mail and language required facts or independently optional?
options: All three are required
Each is independently optional
At least one contact channel is required, with language independently optional
open_points.default_guess: Treat phone, e-mail and language as independently optional because only name and kind are stated as required.

open_points.subject: Ended-relationship time
open_points.text: M04 says the Customer’s marks are “each with the instant the owner set it,” then defines the ended mark “with the date the owner gives,” which may be earlier than the action.
open_points.question: Does an ended relationship retain only its effective end date, or both that date and the instant Registry recorded the mark?
options: Store only the effective end date
Store both the effective end date and recorded-at instant
Store only the recorded-at instant
open_points.default_guess: Store only the effective end date; the Customer’s last-changed instant records the action time while it remains the latest change.

open_points.subject: Imported ArtifactPointer provenance
open_points.text: Every pointer carries its published instant and publishing principal and, conditionally, superseded or withdrawn instants and a withdrawing principal; the import rule only says source instants are kept and does not define missing instants or principals.
open_points.question: How are the required provenance and transition facts populated for an imported pointer when the source does not carry them?
options: Synthesize missing facts at import using the import instant and owner principal
Require every fact in the migration input
Permit imported pointers to omit unavailable provenance facts
open_points.default_guess: Synthesize missing facts at import using the import instant and owner principal.

open_points.subject: AgentSession identity format
open_points.text: The agent session identity is described only as “an opaque identifier” named by Kernel, while State 0 carried the format of every identity to State 1.
open_points.question: What concrete identity form may Kernel supply and Registry persist for an agent session?
options: A UUID
An opaque bounded string
A structured Kernel run-context identifier
open_points.default_guess: Use an opaque bounded string because Registry does not mint or interpret it.

open_points.subject: Archived active project reference
open_points.text: M06 says the active project is “never an archived project” and immediately says “a project archived while active stays active.”
open_points.question: May `active project` reference an archived project when it was active before archiving?
options: Yes, but an archived project cannot newly be made active
No; archiving automatically clears it
Yes, and archived projects may also be selected as active
open_points.default_guess: Allow the existing reference to remain, while refusing any attempt to newly select an archived project.

open_points.subject: AuditEntry identity
open_points.text: M09 classifies AuditEntry as an entity and says two entries with equal facts remain distinct, but its complete fact list contains no audit-entry identity or other discriminator.
open_points.question: What gives two otherwise equal AuditEntry entities distinct identity?
options: A Registry-minted audit entry id
An append position or sequence number
A composite event identity including time and subject
open_points.default_guess: Mint an opaque UUID audit entry id.

open_points.subject: AuditEntry subject variants
open_points.text: M09 says an import entry’s subject is the MigrationClosure, but its subject fact is later limited to a project, customer, or session-and-project; it also gives no subject for erasing old audit entries.
open_points.question: What subject alternatives can an AuditEntry carry for imports and audit-log erasures?
options: Add MigrationClosure and audit-log/cutoff subjects
Allow those entries to have no subject, retaining their action-specific facts
Represent both as owner-session subjects
open_points.default_guess: Add MigrationClosure as the import subject and an audit-log subject qualified by the cutoff date for audit erasure.

open_points.subject: Session removals caused by project erasure
open_points.text: Project erasure removes the project from every AgentSession, while M09 requires entries for project erasure and for revoking a session’s project but does not say whether the induced removals are separately audited.
open_points.question: Does anonymising or deleting a project create one project-erasure entry only, or also one revocation entry for every affected session?
options: Write only the project-erasure entry
Also write a revocation entry for every affected session
Write one aggregate session-removal entry
open_points.default_guess: Write the project-erasure entry plus one revocation entry for each affected session.

open_points.subject: Confirmation of an unchanged action
open_points.text: The identity section says Registry mints a confirmation id whenever the owner confirms archiving or anonymising, and writes it into that action’s audit entry; archived-again and anonymised-again actions return unchanged, while M09 records only significant state changes.
open_points.question: When a confirmed action succeeds as an unchanged no-op, is a confirmation id minted and is an AuditEntry written?
options: Mint neither id nor entry
Mint an id and write an accepted no-op entry
Mint an id but persist no entry
open_points.default_guess: Mint neither a confirmation id nor an audit entry for an unchanged no-op.

open_points.subject: Agent projection artifact selection
open_points.text: The agent projection is said to contain “artifact pointers,” without saying whether that means every historical pointer or only currently published pointers.
open_points.question: Which ArtifactPointer records does reading the agent projection include?
options: All published, superseded and withdrawn pointers
Only currently published pointers
Only the latest pointer per type, including no withdrawn history
open_points.default_guess: Include all pointers because State 0 defines artifact history as every published, superseded and withdrawn pointer.
